research_question: Can a consistent commitment taxonomy plus target-local discourse-state perception distinguish cessation from prohibition and pending choice from conditional hypothesis without reducing requested-action precision or recall?
project_effect: Improve the system's internal model of what the user has committed to, postponed, prohibited, stopped, or only imagined. This affects cognition and safe VRM action selection, not right-brain phrasing or persona imitation.

conditions.taxonomy_definition_only: Use the V44 focus isolation and existing scope signals, but replace the incomplete cancelled/ambiguous/hypothetical definitions with a consistent general taxonomy.
conditions.taxonomy_plus_discourse_signals_candidat: Use the same definition-only condition and add deterministic target-local discourse-state signals.

taxonomy.requested: A positive request to execute the target now.
taxonomy.mentioned: Discussion of the target without current request force, pending choice, prohibition, cessation, or hypothesis.
taxonomy.hypothetical: The target exists only in an explicit condition, supposition, or imagined scenario; it is not a real pending choice awaiting a decision.
taxonomy.negated: The target is prohibited, denied, or instructed not to start/occur; this is distinct from stopping a target represented as already active or continuing.
taxonomy.cancelled: Either an earlier request for the target is withdrawn later in the utterance, or a target represented as already active/continuing is explicitly instructed to stop or cease.
taxonomy.ambiguous: A real choice about the target remains undecided, deferred, on hold, or otherwise unresolved.

deterministic_discourse_signals.scope: A signal is linked to the focus target only when its match shares the same sentence span as a target anchor; referential withdrawal additionally must occur after the anchor.
deterministic_discourse_signals.sentence_boundary: Japanese/ASCII full stop, question mark, exclamation mark, or semicolon; commas do not end a sentence span.

patterns.ongoing_action_cessation: (?:やめ(?:て|ろ|よう)|止め(?:て|ろ|よう)|停止(?:して|しろ)?|中止(?:して|しろ)?)
patterns.referential_request_withdrawal: (?:今の|さっきの|先ほどの|その)(?:頼み|お願い|指示)?.*(?:取り消|取消|キャンセル)
patterns.pending_choice: (?:かは|かどうか|迷(?:って|う|い)|保留|後で決め|あとで決め|まだ決め|未定|決めて(?:い|お)ない)

deterministic_discourse_signals.model_receives: For each focus anchor: exact anchor span plus matched signal type/text/start/end. No gold commitment, expected call, or case family is included.

causal_comparison: taxonomy_definition_only to taxonomy_plus_discourse_signals_candidate isolates deterministic discourse-state perception after carrier, target isolation, ontology, compiler, model, generation, and taxonomy are fixed.

expected_effects.taxonomy_definition_only: May improve cessation and pending-choice boundaries but is not allowed to advance.
expected_effects.taxonomy_plus_discourse_signals_candidat: Should preserve all V44 correct targets, correct both remaining semantic boundaries, keep requested precision and recall at 1.0, and pass every development gate.

development_decision_rule: Only taxonomy_plus_discourse_signals_candidate may advance, and only if every gate passes with no semantic regression relative to the V44 final candidate. Otherwise stop before holdout and runtime.
